title: Beach Dreamer | KEY.co
description_expanded: Beach Dreamer in Watersound, FL, is a stunning three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home designed for ultimate relaxation and convenience. Nestled within the highly sought-after Prominence community, this pet-friendly retreat features a spacious patio and is just steps away from a resort-style pool. The home's large living area boasts a 65" 4K HDR Smart TV, perfect for family movie nights, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and adjacent dining area ensure delightful meal times. Each bedroom offers its own Smart TV, with the master suite providing a king bed and the guest rooms furnished with a queen bed and a fun bunk bed setup. Prominence offers unparalleled access to 17 miles of scenic bike paths, inviting guests to explore the beautiful 30A landscape. The vibrant town center, known as The Big Chill, is a hub of entertainment, featuring an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for movie nights and sporting events, along with concerts, family activities, and a variety of dining and boutique shopping options. Located centrally on 30A, Beach Dreamer is just minutes away from the charming spots of Seagrove, Seaside, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach, making it the perfect base for an unforgettable coastal getaway.

Features: Outdoor seating Community pools Community gas grills
A two-car garage is available and an assigned parking space.
